dlentry.dd: If selected, personal or private information (such as email addresses, phone numbers, IDs, or API keys) is automatically identified and masked in AI requests to help protect sensitive data. You can extend this protection by adding custom patterns for additional data types in the table below this option. Click the New button below the table to configure a new rule pattern, or click the Edit button to modify an existing rule. You can also use Delete to remove rules. The masked information is automatically restored in the AI response, ensuring that users see the correct content and that any generated or updated files remain accurate.Sensitive data masking does not apply to unmasked values passed through action or agent parameters. This includes content supplied through the system prompt or project context. AI Positron sends these values to the AI unchanged and does not display a sensitive-content filtering notification for them.
Opens a dialog box where you can test how specific data is masked before sending it to the AI.

Opens a confirmation dialog box that lets you permanently delete all data stored by AI Positron. This includes personal data (chat history, favorites, caches, recent actions, tokens, keys) and preference settings (stored in either Global Options or Project Options). The confirmation dialog box also includes an option to delete configuration files that are stored separately on disk.
